## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run verify` passes (typecheck + tests)
- [ ] `npm run lint` reports 0 errors
- [ ] If this touches a page/component, I loaded it in a browser and checked the golden path
- [ ] If this touches layout, I checked a narrow mobile viewport (320–375px)
- [ ] This does not add scraping, browser automation, auto-submission, or auto-sending of any kind (see [ARCHITECTURE.md § Non-negotiable design rules](../ARCHITECTURE.md#non-negotiable-design-rules))
- [ ] If this adds an AI-assisted feature, it has a working deterministic fallback
- [ ] If this adds an outward-facing side effect (sends something, submits something, opens a third-party URL), it requires an explicit user confirmation showing the exact content first
